facts.fact: Streaming captures 44–47% of all TV watching time, according to the vendor's page.
facts.quote: 44–47% Streaming captures of all TV watching time

facts.fact: SmartyAds claims 99% of CTV ads achieve high completion.
SmartyAds states 84% of advertisers agree CTV delivers stronger targeting than linear TV.
facts.quote: 84% Advertisers agree – CTV delivers stronger targeting than linear TV

facts.fact: CTV ads are typically priced on a CPM basis, meaning advertisers pay per thousand impressions.
facts.quote: CTV ads are typically priced on a CPM basis, meaning you pay per thousand impressions.

facts.fact: The minimum initial deposit to fund a SmartyAds CTV account is $1000.
facts.quote: At first you need to make a minimum deposit to fund your account – $1000.

facts.fact: Subsequent SmartyAds account top-ups have a minimum of around $500.
facts.quote: Subsequent top-ups have a lower minimum of around $500

facts.fact: CTV ads can appear on smart TVs, streaming devices such as set-top boxes, inside CTV and OTT apps, and across in-app streaming environments.
facts.quote: Within built-in streaming apps and TV interfaces
